title: FacilityMeasurementBatch
description: EWDS Topic schema for Client Gateway payload validation. Batch of interval measurement readings (int:FacilityMeasurement) for multiple Facilities, all belonging to the same Site. All fields other than timestamp are optional since not every metering point captures every quantity. Note: avgLoad and avgGrid from the ontology workbook are marked Removed status and are excluded here.

siteId.description: FK to the Site that all Facilities in this batch belong to.

items.description: Measurement readings for one Facility within the batch.

facilityId.description: FK to the Facility these measurements belong to.

items.description: A single interval measurement reading for a Facility (int:FacilityMeasurement).

tIndoorC.description: Indoor air temperature of the facility in degrees Celsius. Only available where a temperature sensor is physically installed; not all INTELLIGENT pilot facilities have indoor sensors.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the measurements are recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone.

energyIn.description: Average amount of energy imported per interval.

energyOut.description: Average amount of energy exported per interval.
